persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make my fox mascot look like this second picture—the pink and teal vaporwave style. Keep the fox and its orange hoodie, full body. One square picture, no text.

messages.text: Could you make my fox mascot in the first pic look like the second pic, the pink and teal vaporwave reference? I've been wanting to give the mascot a different look, and this reference got me excited about trying it. I want one square picture, keeping the fox and its orange hoodie and showing its full body. The pink and teal vaporwave style in that second pic is what I mean for the makeover. I'm a little nervous about how the style change will turn out, but I'd love to see it. Please don't put any text in the image.
